title: Viakifishi (Theme 1: Usafi wa sehemu za umma)
status: draft: written 18 Nov 2026 offline for Grade 8 Kiswahili; not yet checked by a native Kiswahili teacher; not loaded by the live tutor

skills.key_step: The child uses one alama ya hisi for a feeling or a strong command and the ritifaa for the sound ng' (ng'ombe), and not for anything else.
contexts: cleanliness of public places: "Usitupe taka hapa!"

board.do: ole wetu soko limejaa ngombe na taka
Wait for the child to answer before saying anything.
The child writes "Ole wetu! Soko limejaa ng'ombe na taka."

misconceptions.ask: Soma tena: "Sentensi ya mshangao huisha kwa nini?" Kwa nini "kikomo" si jibu sahihi?
misconceptions.repair: Sentensi ya mshangao huisha kwa alama ya hisi (!).

misconceptions.ask: Soma tena: "Ni neno lipi limeandikwa sawa?" Kwa nini "ngombe" si jibu sahihi?
Soma tena: "Amri kali huisha kwa nini?" Kwa nini "kiulizi" si jibu sahihi?
misconceptions.repair: Amri kali huisha kwa alama ya hisi.
Tumia alama moja ya hisi: Lo!
